title: Dick and Vallée precognize each other's work: VALIS and The Invisible College

tellings.quote: other's work they were both writing uh in 1974 1975 that's when uh valet was writing the invisible college and that's when dick was writing the first draft of what became veis

plain: The researcher Eric Wargo says the science-fiction writer Philip K. Dick and the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée seemed to foresee each other's ideas while writing at the same time, in 1974 and 1975. As Wargo dates it, that is when Vallée was writing his book The Invisible College and Dick was writing Radio Free Albemuth, the first draft of what became his novel VALIS. Wargo offers this to Michels, without naming a source, as an example of how knowledge might travel through time, which is his larger theme.
